other_conditions: Applicant must be unemployed or not in a regular/permanent position
Applicant must hold at least one of the minimum qualifications: a Post Graduate degree (e.g., M.Sc., B.Tech., MBBS), an M.Phil./M.Tech./M.Pharm./M.VSc., or a Ph.D. in Basic or Applied Sciences
Five‑year age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and physically challenged candidates
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹55,000 for Ph.D. holders, ₹40,000 for M.Phil./M.Tech. holders, or ₹31,000 for M.Sc. candidates, with total project cost up to ₹30 lakh, ₹25 lakh, or ₹20 lakh respectively (excluding HRA and overheads).
